name: zc_avatar_why

tests.name: every step was measured with the clock running
the avatar's render cost is dynamic shadows, or it is not

detail.note: reported either way. A large gap between 'shadows on' and 'shadows off' names the cause; a large gap between 'one avatar' and 'hidden' says the cost is in drawing it at all, and a small one says the cost is in merely having it.
